question: Which keyboard key is used to jump the cursor to the next cell of the table in MS Word?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tab**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Tab** key is used to jump the cursor to the next cell of the table in MS Word.
 
• Using the Tab key allows for quick navigation between cells without using a mouse.
 
• It enhances efficiency when working with tables in documents.
 
• Pressing Tab in the last cell of a table will create a new row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In addition to moving to the next cell, the Tab key can also be used to indent text within a cell if the cell is not the last one in the row.
 
• To move to the previous cell, the **Shift + Tab** key combination is used.
 
• Other navigation keys like **Arrow keys** can also be used to move between cells, but they do not create new rows.
